items.name: base
items.title: Prometheus Base
items.description: Prometheus design-system defaults for a new app. Locks Base UI, Geist, Lucide, ember tokens, and the @prometheus namespace. Install this with shadcn init instead of composing a theme by hand.

theme.font-sans: Geist, Geist Fallback, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: Geist Mono, Geist Mono Fallback, ui-monospace, monospace

items.name: prometheus-provider
items.title: Prometheus Provider
items.description: App provider for Prometheus. Supplies isMobile, next-themes, and TooltipProvider once at the root. Use usePrometheus() instead of adding a second breakpoint hook beside every dialog or menu.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Enhanced button with loading, leading/trailing icons, and href rendering. Use this instead of wrapping the primitive with a Spinner and icon spacing on every action.

items.name: simple-tooltip
items.title: Simple Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip with a one-prop API: pass content and a single child trigger. Use this instead of assembling Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, and TooltipContent for a standard hint.

items.name: conditional-tooltip
items.title: Conditional Tooltip
items.description: Renders SimpleTooltip only when a condition and content are present. Use it for disabled explanations without duplicating the trigger in two branches.

items.name: conditional-wrap
items.title: Conditional Wrap
items.description: Conditionally wrap children with a function so optional links, providers, or layouts do not duplicate the child tree in a ternary.

items.name: simple-dialog
items.title: Simple Dialog
items.description: Centered dialog with title, description, trigger, and footer props. Use this for the standard desktop modal. It does not install mobile drawer behavior — use Responsive Dialog when the same interaction must become a sheet on small screens.

items.name: responsive-dialog
items.title: Responsive Dialog
items.description: Same API as Simple Dialog, presented as a swipeable drawer on mobile. Depends on PrometheusProvider for isMobile. Use mobileView="keep" to force the desktop dialog. Do not rebuild a second mobile sheet beside Simple Dialog.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Confirmation modal built on AlertDialog with async loading state and destructive variant. Use this instead of wiring AlertDialog, pending state, and cancel/confirm buttons by hand.

items.name: simple-popover
items.title: Simple Popover
items.description: Desktop popover with trigger, optional header, and positioning props. Does not install mobile drawer behavior — use Responsive Popover when the same content should open as a drawer on mobile.

items.name: responsive-popover
items.title: Responsive Popover
items.description: Same API as Simple Popover, presented as a swipeable drawer on mobile. Depends on PrometheusProvider for isMobile. Use mobileView="keep" to force the desktop popover.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Clipboard copy button with temporary copied feedback built on Prometheus Button. Use this instead of repeating clipboard state and timeout cleanup.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Hydration-safe light/dark toggle wired to next-themes and SimpleTooltip. Pairs with PrometheusProvider.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Title, description, and action slot with optional sticky positioning. Use this instead of rebuilding header layout on every screen.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Shared spinner plus FullPageSpinner and FillHeightSpinner layouts. Use these instead of recentering a Loader icon at each loading boundary.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Keyboard Shortcut
items.description: Visual keycaps for shortcut hints. Display only — bind the actual keys in your app. Use KbdShortcut with a string array instead of hand-styled kbd tags.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User avatar and see-through AvatarStack driven by --avatar-size. Uses CSS radial-gradient masks for true transparent overlap cutouts, automatic crescent initials nudging, topmost direction switching, and overflow count.

items.name: form-field-wrapper
items.title: Form Field Wrapper
items.description: Shared field shell for label, control, description, and error. Wrap custom controls with this instead of inventing a second error layout.

items.name: form-field-input
items.title: Form Field Input
items.description: Labeled text input with description and error wiring. Works with react-hook-form register() or plain value/onChange. Do not rebuild Field + Label + Input for a standard text field.

items.name: form-field-textarea
items.title: Form Field Textarea
items.description: Labeled textarea with the shared field shell. Use this for multiline fields; use the textarea primitive only when you need a custom layout.

items.name: form-field-select
items.title: Form Field Select
items.description: Labeled single-value select from an options array. Use this instead of assembling Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, and Field by hand for a standard choice.

items.name: form-field-checkbox
items.title: Form Field Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox paired with its label and validation message. Use this for standard boolean fields.

items.name: form-field-switch
items.title: Form Field Switch
items.description: Settings-row switch paired with label, description, and validation message. Use this for boolean settings toggles.

items.name: form-field-radio-group
items.title: Form Field Radio Group
items.description: Labeled single-choice radio group from an options array using FieldSet and FieldLegend. Use this instead of assembling RadioGroup and Field rows by hand.

items.name: agent
items.title: Prometheus Agent Pack
items.description: Agent instructions and a Cursor skill that tell models to search Prometheus before writing UI. Installs with the base so every new project starts with the same conventions.
